hero.title: Bring your day.
hero.description: When the day winds down, look back with the Lord and set a stone to remember it.

scripture.heading: A Word to carry
scripture.description: Begin with today’s passage. There is room for your questions as you explore God’s care.

invitation.title: Start where you are.
invitation.description: Grateful, uncertain, or somewhere in between. There is room for all of your days.

onboarding.title: Find a little grounding, wherever you are.
onboarding.description: A new country. New people. Some days full of possibility, others far from home. Make room for what you’re feeling, find encouragement in Scripture, and remember what carries you.
onboarding.privacy: No account needed. Your journal stays on this device. You can add your name and city later in Settings.
onboarding.personalizeNote: What should we call you, and where do you live now? These details stay on your device.

entry.visualNote: Wherever you call home, Jesus is your provider. One stone at a time, remember the Lord’s faithfulness.
entry.title: Welcome to Ebenezer.
entry.description: New to faith, far from home, or full of questions? Explore Jesus’ love through Scripture, prayer, and small moments of reflection.

loved.title: You are always loved.
loved.description: Near or far from home, God’s love goes with you.

provided.title: Jesus is your provider.
provided.description: Bring Him your worries. Remember the ways He has carried you.

together.title: You don’t have to walk alone.
together.description: Invite your prayer warriors to pray with you and encourage one another.

entry.privacy: Your journal is private and saved on this device. No account needed.
entry.profileDescription: Let’s make this space feel a little more like yours. You can also skip this and settle in first.
entry.choose: How would you like to begin?

account.title: Create an account
account.description: Sign in with Google to share stones, pray with friends and join groups.

local.title: Use my name and city
local.description: No account. Your name and city stay on this device.

explore.title: Just look around
explore.description: Go straight in. You can add details any time in Settings.

entry.accountDescription: An account lets you share on the board, pray with friends and join groups. Your journal stays private on this device.

encouragement.title: A little encouragement
encouragement.description: Choose a Scripture theme and make room for a short prayer.
encouragement.privacy: Only a public Scripture theme, language, selected calendar occasion, and optional weather category are sent to Google AI. Google’s free tier may use them to improve its products. Your journal, name, city, coordinates, and prayer requests are never sent to Google.
encouragement.offline: Connect to request encouragement. Your local journal is still available.
encouragement.failed: Encouragement could not load. Please try again.

source.ai: AI-assisted encouragement · Scripture is shown separately.
source.prepared: Prepared encouragement · available when AI is off or unavailable.

encouragement.question: To reflect on:

morning.title: A Word for today
morning.weatherPrivacy: Check weather for {{city}}? Your city is sent to Open-Meteo. Only a broad weather category goes to Google AI; weather does not tell us how you feel.
morning.weatherFailed: Weather is unavailable. Today’s Word is still here.

christmas.title: Christmas
christmas.context: Christians celebrate Jesus’ birth at Christmas. This passage announces His birth as good news.

easter.title: Easter · Western calendar
easter.context: At Easter, Christians celebrate Jesus’ resurrection. Explore this invitation to remember His risen life.

goodFriday.title: Good Friday · Western calendar
goodFriday.context: Good Friday remembers Jesus’ death. This passage points to God’s love shown through Christ.

newYear.title: New Year
newYear.context: At the beginning of a year, pause with this passage about God’s faithfulness.

prepared.remember: Take a quiet moment with this Word. You can begin noticing God’s faithful care, even while questions remain.
prepared.care: You can bring what is on your heart to Jesus. His invitation makes room for you as you are today.
prepared.steadiness: There is room for an overwhelmed heart in this passage. Pause, breathe, and bring your next step to Jesus.
prepared.occasion: Make a little room to explore what this passage reveals about Jesus and His love.

morning.preparedPrayer: Jesus, help me understand Your love and carry this Word into my day. Amen.
morning.preparedQuestion: What would you like to carry into today?
morning.thoughtPlaceholder: One small thought for the day ahead…
carryWays: Before your first class or task, read it once more and take a slow breath.
When the day feels heavy, pause and say it again as a short prayer.
Tonight, we’ll bring it back so you can notice how God met you.
